column1: Details of investor complaints are typically filed with Stock Exchanges and the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) on a quarterly basis. Companies are required to report the number of complaints received, resolved, and pending during each quarter. This information is often included in their quarterly financial results and disclosures.
